You are implementing a major expansion of the admin kanban "board" feature in the Nxeon platform at /opt/nxeon (Next.js App Router + Prisma + Tailwind). Do the three epics IN ORDER (each builds on the last; they touch the same files, so they must be sequential within your single agent — do not parallelize them). Typecheck between epics. This is production code — be careful and cohesive.

VERIFIED CODEBASE MAP:
- Schema: prisma/schema.prisma lines ~893–978. Models: `Board`(id,name,createdAt,columns,cards — NO scoping field), `BoardColumn`(id,boardId,name,position,cards), `Card`(id,boardId,columnId,title,description markdown,type CardType[IDEA|FEATURE|BUG|CHORE],priority CardPriority[LOW|NORMAL|HIGH|URGENT],labels String[],assignee String?,position,archivedAt,createdAt,updatedAt), `CardAttachment`, `CardComment`(cardId,authorName,body,createdAt).
- Server actions: lib/actions-board.ts ("use server", all gated by requireAdmin()): listBoards, createBoard, renameBoard, deleteBoard, getBoard, createColumn, renameColumn, deleteColumn, createCard, updateCard, moveCard(cardId,toColumnId,toIndex), archiveCard, deleteCard, getCard, addComment, deleteAttachment. Default columns: ["Ideas","Backlog","In progress","Review","Done"]. Every mutation calls revalidatePath("/admin/board"). Exported types: BoardSummary, CardSummary, ColumnData, BoardData, CardDetail.
- UI: app/admin/board/page.tsx (server component, requireArea("platform"), reads ?b=<boardId>, renders <BoardClient>). components/admin/BoardClient.tsx (~301 lines: BoardClient, Column, NewColumn, CardModal in one file). DnD is hand-rolled native HTML5 (draggable + onDragStart/onDragOver/onDrop; a single `drag` state holds the dragged card id; onDrop does optimistic splice then moveCard). Columns are fixed w-72, shrink-0, in a flex overflow-x-auto row. Layout container: `div.flex h-[calc(100vh-6.5rem)] flex-col gap-3` — no own max-width; side "dead space" comes from the shared /admin layout wrapper (find its max-w-*/px-* and reduce it for the board route).
- Attachments: app/api/board/attachments/route.ts (POST upload) + [id]/route.ts. lib/board-shared.ts has BOARD_UPLOAD_DIR.
- Deploy/pipeline primitives (for Epic C): scripts/publish-docs.mjs (renders docs/DOCUMENTATION.md → static HTML), scripts/deploy-staging.sh, scripts/promote-production.sh, .git/hooks/post-commit (auto-pushes commits to origin main). Improvements feature (lib/actions-improvements.ts + ImprovementsBoard.tsx) and ClaudeBuild approval-gated execution (lib/actions-claude.ts) are precedents for stage-gated backend actions.
- NO dnd library installed. NO card search exists. NO app/product entity exists (only Board.name as an informal proxy; default board seeded named "Nxeon").

EPIC A — Bind boards to apps:
- Add a lightweight `App` model (id, name, slug @unique, color String?, createdAt) and add nullable `appId String?` + relation on `Board` (index it). Run `npx prisma db push` (this DB uses db push, not migrate — confirm by checking package.json scripts / how staging deploy does it; deploy-staging.sh uses `prisma db push`).
- Seed apps: Nxeon, Soul Pilates, studionexis (idempotent). Backfill: assign existing boards to an app by matching Board.name (e.g. a board named "Nxeon" → Nxeon app); leave unmatched boards appId null ("Unassigned").
- Server actions: listApps, createApp(name), and make listBoards accept an optional appId filter; createBoard accepts an appId. 
- UI: add an App switcher (tabs or a select) at the top of the board page that filters boards by app; persist selection via ?app= query param alongside ?b=. Add "New app" affordance.

EPIC B — Board UX beef-up (all in BoardClient.tsx + a couple new actions):
- Inline-editable column/pipeline names (double-click to rename → renameColumn). Column reordering via drag. A drag-to-delete drop zone (drag a card onto a trash zone → confirm → deleteCard; and allow deleting empty columns).
- Improve drag-and-drop UX: clear drop indicators/placeholders, smoother cross-column moves. You MAY add `@dnd-kit/core`+`@dnd-kit/sortable` (add to package.json, npm install) if it yields materially better UX than the native handlers — your call, but keep it working and typechecked.
- Full-text card search: new server action searchCards(boardId or appId, query) querying Card.title + Card.description + CardComment.body (Postgres ILIKE/contains). Add a search box that shows matching cards (highlight where matched). Mirror the client-side search pattern in app/admin/docs/page.tsx if useful.
- Denser layout: reduce column width, and fix the side dead-space by overriding the /admin shell container max-width/padding for the board route (find the wrapper). Make the board use the full width.
- New useful features (add several that fit): filter/sort by type/priority/label/assignee; per-column card counts; quick-add card inline at column bottom; card labels as colored chips; show updatedAt/"last activity"; keyboard shortcuts (e.g. "/" focuses search, "n" new card). Keep it cohesive with the existing dark Nxeon theme.

EPIC C — Execution pipeline (stage transitions trigger real actions), built SAFELY behind explicit confirmation:
- Concept: moving a card into certain stages can push work to: Docs (append/update docs/DOCUMENTATION.md + run scripts/publish-docs.mjs), Staging (scripts/deploy-staging.sh), Production (scripts/promote-production.sh), GitHub (git commit → post-commit hook auto-pushes).
- Implement a new admin-gated server action runCardStageAction(cardId, action) that invokes the relevant script via child_process, captures output, and records the result as a CardComment (or a small CardActivity log) on the card. Do NOT wire these to fire AUTOMATICALLY on moveCard — instead expose them as explicit buttons in the CardModal (e.g. "Publish to docs", "Deploy to staging", "Promote to production", "Commit to GitHub") each behind a confirm dialog. Production/GitHub especially must require confirmation. Add a per-card or per-column optional "stage → suggested action" mapping so the UI hints which action a stage implies, but the human always clicks to execute.
- Keep it defensive: long scripts should run detached with output captured to a log the action can read back; never block the request thread indefinitely.

AFTER each epic run the project's typecheck (check package.json for the script name, e.g. `npm run typecheck` or `npx tsc --noEmit`) and fix errors. At the very end, run `npm run build` to catch build errors and fix them. Do NOT promote to production. If you can, deploy to STAGING (scripts/deploy-staging.sh) and confirm the board page renders, but do not run promote-production.sh.

CONSTRAINTS:
- You OWN prisma/schema.prisma, lib/actions-board.ts, components/admin/BoardClient.tsx, app/admin/board/*, and new board files. Another agent is concurrently doing DATA-ONLY email work (no schema edits) — if you run `prisma db push`, that's fine; just don't touch email/mailbox code.
- Preserve all existing board behavior (attachments, comments, requireAdmin gating, revalidatePath).
- If a safety classifier blocks a command, do not circumvent it maliciously — report it and continue with what you can.

Return a structured report: what shipped per epic, schema changes, any new deps, files touched, typecheck/build status, staging deploy status, and any incomplete items or follow-ups.

// ============================================================================
// PROJECT BOARD (internal kanban for managing Nxeon)
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// A Trello-style board: Board → columns (stages) → cards (ideas/features/bugs),
// with attachments (screenshots, files, videos) stored on this server's disk so
// they can be read + acted on directly, and comments. Admin-only.
// ============================================================================

enum CardType {
  IDEA
  FEATURE
  BUG
  CHORE
}

enum CardPriority {
  LOW
  NORMAL
  HIGH
  URGENT
}

enum AttachmentKind {
  IMAGE
  VIDEO
  FILE
}

model Board {
  id        String        @id @default(cuid())
  name      String
  createdAt DateTime      @default(now())
  columns   BoardColumn[]
  cards     Card[]
}

model BoardColumn {
  id       String  @id @default(cuid())
  boardId  String
  board    Board   @relation(fields: [boardId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  name     String
  position Int     @default(0)
  cards    Card[]

  @@index([boardId])
}

model Card {
  id          String           @id @default(cuid())
  boardId     String
  board       Board            @relation(fields: [boardId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  columnId    String
  column      BoardColumn      @relation(fields: [columnId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  title       String
  description String           @default("") // markdown
  type        CardType         @default(FEATURE)
  priority    CardPriority     @default(NORMAL)
  labels      String[]         @default([])

## Project board — apps, UX overhaul, execution pipeline (2026-08-04)

The admin-only kanban at `/admin/board` (models `Board`/`BoardColumn`/`Card`/`CardComment`/`CardAttachment`
in `prisma/schema.prisma`; actions in `lib/actions-board.ts`; UI in `components/admin/BoardClient.tsx`)
gained three layers.

**Apps.** New `App` model (`id`, `name`, `slug` @unique, `color`, `createdAt`) and a nullable
`Board.appId` relation (indexed, `onDelete: SetNull`). Seeded idempotently in `prisma/seed.ts`: **Nxeon**,
**Soul Pilates**, **studionexis**; existing boards are backfilled to an app by name match (unmatched stay
"Unassigned"). Actions: `listApps`, `createApp(name)`, `listBoards(appId?)`, `createBoard(name, appId?)`.
The board page has an **App switcher** (All / per-app / Unassigned + "+ App"); selection persists via
`?app=` alongside `?b=`. Schema applied with `prisma db push` (this DB uses push, not migrate).

**UX.** Full-width (added `/admin/board` to `Shell.tsx`'s `fullBleed` list, removing the `max-w-7xl` dead
space) and denser (`w-64` columns). Columns: double-click header to rename (`renameColumn`), drag header to
reorder (`moveColumn`), delete-when-empty ✕. Cards: hand-rolled HTML5 DnD kept (no new dep — native
handlers were sufficient) but with **drop-indicator bars**, a **drag-to-delete trash zone**, colored
**label chips**, and a **"last activity"** relative timestamp (`Card.updatedAt`, now surfaced on
`CardSummary`). New **full-text search** (`searchCards({boardId|appId}, query)` — Postgres
`contains`/`mode:"insensitive"` over title + description + comment bodies) with a highlighted results
dropdown. Toolbar **filters** (type/priority/assignee/label) and **sort** (manual/priority/last-activity/
title); drag is auto-disabled while filtered/sorted to keep positions correct. Keyboard shortcuts: `/`
focuses search, `n` opens the first column's quick-add.

**Execution pipeline.** `runCardStageAction(cardId, action)` (admin-gated) runs a fixed, allowlisted
script per action — `docs` → `scripts/publish-docs.mjs`, `staging` → `scripts/deploy-staging.sh`,
`production` → `scripts/promote-production.sh`, `github` → `git add -A && git commit` (post-commit hook
auto-pushes). It **never fires on card move** — only via **confirm-gated buttons in the card modal**
(production/GitHub get an extra warning). The child is **spawned detached** with stdout/stderr captured to
a per-run log under `board-uploads/stage-logs/`; a start comment is posted immediately and a completion
comment (with the log tail) when the child exits, so the request never blocks on a long deploy. Column
names hint the suggested action (`suggestedActionForColumn`, in `lib/board-shared.ts` so the client can use
it synchronously — the `"use server"` module can only export async functions). **Caveat:** the web process
runs as the unprivileged `nxeon` user, so `staging`/`production` (systemctl/chown) and `github` (root-owned
`.git`) will fail with permission errors when triggered from the web context until passwordless sudo for
those specific scripts is wired — the failure is captured cleanly in the card's log/comment.
